categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在 LLM 记忆机制、过程奖励与推理成本控制，以及模型路由、信息抽取和电商推荐的落地方法。

articles.title: Instant Weight-Space Consolidation for Long-Term Memory in LLMs
articles.zh: LLM 长期记忆的即时权重空间巩固
articles.summary: 如果你在做 LLM 记忆机制，这篇直接从权重空间下手做记忆巩固，比外挂向量库更"内化"，但可解释性和更新成本得留个心眼
articles.author: Manan Suri, Dinesh Manocha
articles.body: Agentic memory systems give LLMs persistent memory by extracting experience into text and retrieving it at query time, but the model itself does not evolve: however many interactions it has had, it starts each query the same. Extraction errors compound, implicit cross-session patterns that no single fragment states cannot be surfaced, and the construction cost grows with every conversation. Fine-tuning on past interactions does change the weights, but requires backpropagation at serving time and degrades on long histories. We introduce CLAM (Carried Latent Adapter Memory), which combines the strengths of both: a recurrent hypernetwork performs parametric consolidation, compiling a stream of session activations into a low-rank adapter in a single forward pass with no gradient steps and no language-model generation calls, while a complementary episodic buffer supplies verbatim detail at inference. A gated latent state carries knowledge across sessions in fixed size, so the parametric memory accumulates without growing. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S across three open models (2-7B parameters), CLAM leads all agentic baselines by 1-45 points and all gradient-based parametric methods by 10-45 points, while requiring zero generative LLM calls, zero gradient steps, and 3-151x less wall-clock time than extraction systems to build its memory. The two channels are complementary: the consolidated adapter adds 12-15 accuracy points when the episodic buffer misses the gold evidence, and still adds 4-5 points even with an oracle buffer.
articles.bodyZh: 智能体式记忆系统（Agentic memory systems）会给大语言模型（LLMs）加上持久记忆（persistent memory）：先把经验提炼成文字，查询时再取出来用。但模型本身并不会进化——不管它之前经历过多少次交互，每次查询时还是从同一个状态开始。提取过程中的错误会越积越多；那些跨会话的隐含模式，只要没有任何一个片段明确说出来，就没法被挖出来；而且每多一轮对话，构建成本都会往上涨。拿过去的交互做微调（fine-tuning）确实能改变模型权重（weights），但要在服务阶段做反向传播（backpropagation），而且历史一长效果就会变差。我们提出 CLAM（Carried Latent Adapter Memory，可携带潜在适配器记忆），把这两种思路的优点合到一起：一个循环超网络（recurrent hypernetwork）做参数化巩固（parametric consolidation），在一次前向传播（single forward pass）里把一连串会话激活（session activations）整合成一个低秩适配器（low-rank adapter），全程不用梯度步骤（gradient steps），也不用调用语言模型来生成（language-model generation calls）；同时，一个互补的情景缓冲器（episodic buffer）在推理（inference）时提供逐字细节。一个带门控的潜在状态（gated latent state）以固定大小跨会话携带知识，所以参数化记忆（parametric memory）能不断积累，但体积不会膨胀。在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 两个基准上，用三个开源模型（open models，2-7B 参数）测试，CLAM 比所有智能体基线（agentic baselines）高 1 到 45 个百分点，比所有基于梯度的参数化方法高 10 到 45 个百分点；同时它不需要任何生成式大语言模型调用（generative LLM calls），不需要任何梯度步骤，构建记忆的实际耗时（wall-clock time）比提取式系统（extraction systems）低 3 到 151 倍。这两个通道是互补的：当情景缓冲器没抓到标准答案证据（gold evidence）时，巩固后的适配器（consolidated adapter）能带来 12 到 15 个准确率百分点的提升；就算给它一个理想缓冲器（oracle buffer），也还能再提升 4 到 5 个百分点。

articles.title: GPRM: Global Perspective Process Reward Model
articles.zh: GPRM：全局视角的过程奖励模型
articles.summary: 如果你在用 PRM 给推理过程逐步打分，这篇提醒你局部评分容易只见树木，得用全局视角重新校准
articles.author: Zifan Zhang, Zhengbo Jiao 等
articles.body: Process Reward Models (PRMs) are widely used for step-level evaluation of multi-step reasoning in large language models, but existing methods are often limited by weak historical dependency modeling and insufficient global awareness. They typically fail to leverage prior step evaluations for coherent judgment and lack visibility into subsequent reasoning, leading to suboptimal assessment of intermediate steps. To address this issue, we propose the Global Perspective Process Reward Model (GPRM), which jointly models the problem, previous reasoning steps and their evaluations, the current step, and future steps to enable history-aware and globally informed process evaluation. We further introduce a structured evaluation framework along four dimensions---look back, look ahead, self-check, and goal alignment---to assess prior consistency, future plausibility, step validity, and task alignment. Based on this framework, we construct datasets for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (GRPO). Experiments show that, despite using less training data and smaller model sizes, GPRM outperforms strong baseline models by 7.8 and 5.4 points on PRMBench and ProcessBench, respectively. GPRM also generalizes well across tasks, surpassing the GPT-4.1 baseline on Agent Error Bench, improving strong baselines by around 4 points under test-time scaling (TTS), and achieving competitive performance on PPE.
articles.bodyZh: 过程奖励模型（Process Reward Models, PRMs）在大语言模型的多步推理里，常被用来做步骤级评估，但现有方法往往受限于历史依赖建模偏弱、全局意识不够。它们通常没法利用前面步骤的评估来做连贯判断，也看不到后续推理，结果对中间步骤的评估不够理想。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了全局视角过程奖励模型（Global Perspective Process Reward Model, GPRM），它把题目、之前的推理步骤及其评估、当前步骤和后续步骤放在一起建模，让过程评估既能回看历史，又能掌握全局信息。我们还引入了一个结构化评估框架，从四个维度来做评估——回看（look back）、前瞻（look ahead）、自查（self-check）和目标对齐（goal alignment），分别判断前面是否一致、后续是否合理、当前步骤是否有效，以及是否对齐任务目标。基于这个框架，我们构建了用于监督微调（supervised fine-tuning, SFT）和强化学习（GRPO）的数据集。实验表明，尽管用的训练数据更少、模型规模也更小，GPRM在PRMBench和ProcessBench上分别比强基线模型高出7.8分和5.4分。GPRM的跨任务泛化能力也不错，在Agent Error Bench上超过了GPT-4.1基线，在测试时扩展（test-time scaling, TTS）下把强基线提升了大约4分，在PPE上也拿到了有竞争力的表现。

articles.title: GainCtrl: Predicting Remaining Gains for Efficient LLM Agent Execution
articles.zh: GainCtrl：预测剩余收益以实现高效的 LLM Agent 执行
articles.summary: 如果你在跑多步 Agent 又嫌推理成本高，这个思路是先估"还能涨多少分"再决定要不要继续跑
articles.author: Kangwen Zhao, Jianfeng Cai 等
articles.body: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used to power agents that interact with tools and environments to solve complex tasks. Repeated attempts improve the quality of tool-using agents, but continued execution incurs additional costs even when it is unlikely to improve the best result ultimately returned. This raises the question of when to stop an attempt to reduce execution cost while preserving task-level Best-of-N quality. To address this question, we introduce GainCtrl, a gain-based execution controller for LLMs. In GainCtrl, a lightweight CPU predictor uses interaction histories to estimate expected positive gains over retained scores, which are then used to guide stopping decisions with calibrated thresholds to limit the loss in mean Best-of-N task quality. We evaluate the controller through trajectory replay across three environments and three LLM actors. Comparisons of interpolated quality-cost Pareto frontiers show that GainCtrl generally uses fewer tokens than baselines at matched target quality. Fixed policies also achieve quality close to that of full execution while substantially reducing token consumption. The predictor runs at millisecond latency on a single CPU thread, supporting repeated monitoring without access to LLM internals.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（LLMs）现在经常被用来驱动智能体（agents），让它们跟工具和环境打交道，去解决复杂任务。多试几次确实能让使用工具的智能体表现更好，但一直跑下去会增加额外成本，哪怕这些尝试大概率已经没法再提升最终返回的最好结果。于是就有一个问题：一次尝试到底该在什么时候停下来，才能既压低执行成本，又不牺牲任务层面的 N 次尝试取最优（Best-of-N）质量？为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 GainCtrl，一个面向 LLM 的、基于收益的执行控制器（execution controller）。在 GainCtrl 里，一个轻量级 CPU 预测器（predictor）会利用交互历史，估算相比当前保留分数（retained scores）还能带来多少正向收益；再用校准过的阈值（calibrated thresholds）来指导停止决策，把平均 Best-of-N 任务质量的损失控制住。我们通过轨迹回放（trajectory replay），在三个环境和三个 LLM 执行模型上评估了这个控制器。比较插值后的质量-成本帕累托前沿（Pareto frontiers）可以看到，在目标质量相同的情况下，GainCtrl 通常比基线方法消耗更少词元（token）。固定的停止策略（Fixed policies）也能做到接近完整执行的质量，同时大幅减少词元消耗。这个预测器在单个 CPU 线程上以毫秒级延迟运行，不需要接触 LLM 内部，就能支持反复监控。

articles.title: Can LLMs Give Good Product Advice? A Framework for Diagnosing Failures
articles.zh: LLM 能给出好的商品建议吗？一套诊断失败模式的框架
articles.summary: 如果你打算让模型做导购或推荐，这篇给了一套拆解它在哪儿翻车的方法，别急着直接上线
articles.author: Assaf Hallak, Yftah Ziser 等
articles.body: Evaluating product advice from a language model requires assessing whether the recommendation meets the user's needs and identifying where the model falls short when it does not. However, matching a product mentioned in an online reply cannot answer either question on its own: several products may be suitable, and the recorded answer may itself be poor advice. When shown a community-listed alternative alongside their own sampled car recommendation, six models prefer the alternative in 1.9 to 6.5 percent of eligible disagreements, consistently across both source-blind presentation orders. We propose a diagnostic framework that separates the user's stated needs, the model's added assumptions, candidate generation, filtering, and final choice, with 19 possible failure modes and the evidence needed to assess them. We apply this framework to product-advice data and to a separate product-selection task with externally assigned relevance labels. The experiments distinguish naming a community-listed product from selecting it and show how answer extraction and candidate-list construction affect the outcome.
articles.bodyZh: 要判断一个语言模型（language model）给的产品建议靠不靠谱，得看两件事：它推荐的东西是不是真能满足用户需求；如果没满足，又是在哪儿掉了链子。但光靠匹配在线回复里提到的某个产品，这两个问题都回答不了：合适的产品可能有好几个，而且模型记录下来的答案本身也可能就是个馊主意。研究人员给六个模型同时看了两样东西：一个是社区里列出的替代选项，一个是模型自己抽样给出的汽车推荐。结果在符合条件的“分歧”里，这六个模型有1.9%到6.5%的情况更偏向那个替代选项，而且在两种“来源盲”的呈现顺序（source-blind presentation orders）下，结果都一致。我们提出了一套诊断框架（diagnostic framework），把用户明确说出的需求、模型自己额外加的假设、候选生成（candidate generation）、过滤（filtering）和最终选择拆开来看，还列出了19种可能的失败模式（failure modes），以及评估每种失败模式需要什么证据。我们用这套框架分析了产品建议数据，也分析了一个单独的产品选择任务，这个任务里的相关性标签（relevance labels）是外部给的。实验把“提到一个社区列出的产品”和“真正选中它”区分开了，也说明了答案抽取（answer extraction）和候选列表构建（candidate-list construction）会怎么影响最后的结果。

articles.title: MemEmo: Evaluating Emotion in Memory Systems
articles.zh: MemEmo：评估记忆系统中的情感
articles.summary: 如果你在做带记忆的陪伴型 Agent，光记住事实不够，这篇专门测它记不记得住用户的情绪
articles.author: Peng Liu, Zhen Tao 等
articles.body: Memory systems address the challenge of context loss in Large Language Models during prolonged interactions. However, as an essential tool for warm companionship and personalized services, the effectiveness of memory systems in processing affective information remains underexamined. To bridge this gap, we propose an emotion-enhanced memory evaluation benchmark to assess the performance of mainstream and state-of-the-art memory systems in integrating and harnessing emotional information. First, we design a benchmark called \textbf{MemEmo} to assess the affective reasoning and tracking capabilities of memory systems across four dimensions: emotional information extraction, emotional memory updating, emotional memory question-answering, and emotional conflict detection. Second, we construct the \textbf{H}uman-\textbf{L}ike \textbf{M}emory \textbf{E}motion (\textbf{HLME}) dataset to provide an empirical foundation for scrutinizing memory systems. Finally, We evaluate five representative memory systems on the HLME dataset, reporting 11 performance metrics across four dimensions. Experimental results reveal that aggregating scores for all tested memory systems is up to 45\%, far below 100\% scale, exposing a profound disparity between memory system and affective intelligence.
articles.bodyZh: 记忆系统（memory systems）要解决的，是大型语言模型（Large Language Models）在长时间互动中“忘了上下文”的问题。不过，作为提供温暖陪伴和个性化服务的关键工具，记忆系统在处理情感信息（affective information）时到底好不好用，目前研究得还不够。为了补上这个缺口，我们提出了一个“情感增强型记忆评测基准”（emotion-enhanced memory evaluation benchmark），用来评估主流和最先进的记忆系统在整合和利用情感信息方面的表现。首先，我们设计了一个叫 MemEmo 的基准，从四个维度考察记忆系统的情感推理和追踪能力：情感信息提取、情感记忆更新、情感记忆问答，以及情感冲突检测。其次，我们构建了“类人记忆情绪”（Human-Like Memory Emotion，HLME）数据集，为深入检验记忆系统提供实证基础。最后，我们在 HLME 数据集上评估了五种有代表性的记忆系统，并围绕四个维度报告了 11 项性能指标（performance metrics）。实验结果显示，所有被测记忆系统的汇总得分最高只有 45%，远低于 100% 的满分，这暴露出记忆系统和情感智能（affective intelligence）之间还存在很大的差距。

articles.title: Routing Beyond Task Categories: A Cost-Aware LAB-Bench Study
articles.zh: 超越任务类别的路由：一项成本感知的 LAB-Bench 研究
articles.summary: 如果你在做模型路由省成本，别只按任务类型分流，这篇说成本感知的路由更值得看
articles.author: Ahmed Tariq, Leo Guinan
articles.body: We tested whether features of biology questions or of a model's first answer can improve accuracy within an inference budget. In a LAB-Bench pilot, we compared a category router with one that adds six structural features. Neither reached the primary 80% accuracy target on development. At the 50% and 60% secondary targets, both chose Haiku for all 120 held-out questions and scored 71/120. We then froze a new comparison before collecting responses on 144 additional questions. Semantic routing scored 86/144. A policy that could defer after reading Haiku's answer scored 87/144. Both stayed within the inference budget of USD 0.678 per 1,000 queries. Against a 95% Haiku and 5% GPT mixture, the accuracy gains were 0.66 percentage points for semantic routing and 1.35 points for deferral. The paired 95% intervals were [-0.28,2.25] and [-0.14,3.47] points. A simple rule that escalated Haiku nonanswers scored 92/144 at USD 0.710 per 1,000 queries, above the budget. A retrospective nonanswer rule with a calibration-selected escalation probability gave an expected 85.63/144. At the learned deferral policy's observed inference cost, post hoc interpolation gave an expected 86.14/144. In a later development check, Astra and Gemini each scored 30/40. The best tested policy in each router family matched that score. The pair covered 33/40 in hindsight. The routers missed the 32/40 criterion, so the proposed 120-question evaluation did not start.
articles.bodyZh: 我们测试了一件事：生物学题目的特征，或者模型第一次回答的特征，能不能在给定的推理预算（inference budget）内把准确率提上去。在 LAB-Bench 试点（pilot）里，我们拿一个类别路由器（category router）和另一个加了六个结构特征（structural features）的路由器做对比。结果在开发集上，两个都没达到主要目标——80% 的准确率。到了 50% 和 60% 这两个次级目标上，两者都给全部 120 道留出题（held-out questions）选了 Haiku，得分 71/120。接着，我们在收集另外 144 道题的回答之前，先把一个新的对比方案定死。语义路由（Semantic routing）得了 86/144。另一种策略可以看完 Haiku 的回答后再决定延后处理（deferral），得了 87/144。两者都没超每 1000 次查询 0.678 美元的推理预算。跟“95% Haiku + 5% GPT”的混合方案（mixture）比，语义路由的准确率提升是 0.66 个百分点，延后策略提升 1.35 个百分点。配对 95% 区间（paired 95% intervals）分别是 [-0.28, 2.25] 和 [-0.14, 3.47] 个百分点。一个简单规则是把 Haiku 没答上来的题升级处理（escalated），得分 92/144，但成本是每 1000 次查询 0.710 美元，超预算了。一个事后回看的“未作答”规则，配合校准选出的升级概率（calibration-selected escalation probability），期望得分是 85.63/144。按学到的延后策略实际观测到的推理成本来算，事后插值（post hoc interpolation）给出的期望得分是 86.14/144。后来做开发检查（development check）时，Astra 和 Gemini 各得 30/40。每个路由器家族（router family）里测试过的最佳策略都追平了这个分数。事后看（hindsight），这一对模型覆盖了 33/40。路由器没达到 32/40 的门槛，所以原计划的 120 题评估没有启动。

articles.title: ANCHOR: Cluster-Grounded 5W1H Extraction via Large-Small Model Collaboration
articles.zh: ANCHOR：基于聚类的 5W1H 抽取，大小模型协同
articles.summary: 如果你要从海量文本里抽事件要素，大小模型分工这套打法在成本和质量之间找平衡，值得抄作业
articles.author: Hongyu Jiang, Chenang Cai 等
articles.body: Deep semantic understanding of events requires recognizing related events and distinguishing why an event occurs from how it is carried out. 5W1H extraction provides a structured foundation for such understanding by organizing event information around six fundamental questions. However, single-event slot filling provides limited support for these distinctions. We propose ANCHOR, a cluster-grounded framework that combines a large language model (LLM) with a small language model equipped with discriminative heads for accurate 5W1H extraction. The LLM proposes candidate events and generates their initial 4W records, which guide the selection of an event cluster and the subsequent anchoring of its main event. A shared document encoder provides evidence for joint 4W refinement, and two separate sets of boundary and role-scoring heads then extract why and how under event-specific constraints, respectively. Document representations are reused across events and stages, and unsupported roles can remain empty. Following the same principles, an agent-and-skill annotation workflow constructs a benchmark of 26,110 documents from ten source corpora covering three languages and seven domains. We select nine of the resulting datasets to evaluate ANCHOR against strong baselines using four open-weight LLMs. ANCHOR achieves competitive performance. The datasets and code are available at https://github.com/revolution6575/ANCHOR-5W1H.
articles.bodyZh: 要想真正吃透事件的深层语义（deep semantic understanding of events），就得能认出相关事件，还要分得清一件事为什么会发生、又是怎么执行落地的。5W1H提取（5W1H extraction）围绕六个基本问题来组织事件信息，为这种理解打下一个结构化的底子。但只做单事件槽填充（single-event slot filling），对上面这些区分帮助有限。我们提出ANCHOR，这是一个基于事件簇（event cluster）的框架，把大语言模型（LLM）和一个带判别头（discriminative heads）的小语言模型（small language model）结合起来，用来更准确地抽取5W1H。LLM负责提出候选事件，并生成它们最初的4W记录（who、what、when、where），这些记录会指导选出一个事件簇，再把簇里的主事件（main event）锚定出来。共享的文档编码器（document encoder）给4W的联合修正提供依据；接着两套分开的边界与角色打分头（boundary and role-scoring heads）分别在具体事件的约束下抽取“为什么”和“怎么做”。文档表示（document representations）会在不同事件、不同阶段之间反复复用，没有依据支撑的角色可以留空。按照同样的思路，我们设计了一个智能体与技能标注流程（agent-and-skill annotation workflow），从十个来源语料库构建了一个包含26,110篇文档的基准（benchmark），覆盖三种语言和七个领域。我们从中挑了九个数据集，用四个开放权重的大语言模型（open-weight LLMs）把ANCHOR和强基线（strong baselines）做对比。ANCHOR表现出了有竞争力的效果。数据集和代码已经公开在 https://github.com/revolution6575/ANCHOR-5W1H。

articles.title: PEETS: Preference-aware Embeddings with Explicit Tree Structure for Auxiliary Product Bundling
articles.zh: PEETS：融合显式树结构的偏好感知 Embedding，用于辅助商品捆绑
articles.summary: 如果你做电商组合推荐，这篇把商品层级树和用户偏好一起塞进 Embedding，比平铺召回更贴近真实搭配逻辑
articles.author: Maolei Huang, Jing Tian 等
articles.body: Auxiliary products such as flight protection and flexible-change services are recommended alongside primary travel purchases. This setting creates a granularity ambiguity: SKUs within one product type share semantics but differ in price and coverage, while rejecting one offer does not imply disinterest in the entire type. We present \textbf{PEETS} (\textbf{P}reference-aware \textbf{E}mbeddings with \textbf{E}xplicit \textbf{T}ree \textbf{S}tructure), a training-time framework for auxiliary product bundling. PEETS regularizes an existing click--conversion predictor through two conditional comparisons. Hierarchical Contrastive Loss uses the pair's common ancestor as a reference; Negative Contrastive Loss conditions structural sampling and comparison shifts on logged rejection events. Both act on shared SKU representations during training. This separates catalog relatedness from individual preference supervision and leaves the predictive serving path intact. PEETS achieves 78.20\% AUC, exceeding TWIN V2 by 0.90 percentage points and the matched base model by 1.15 points. In a 14-day online evaluation, gross auxiliary GMV per exposed user-day improves by 8.20\% over Policies, 3.06\% over Base, and 0.84\% over TWIN V2, with all three user-bootstrap 95\% intervals above zero. Bundling rate is 0.51 points below Policies. The cancellation interval's upper limit exceeds the prespecified margin. PEETS adds no auxiliary-loss computation to serving and records 42.1~ms p95 latency, compared with 42.0~ms for Base.
articles.bodyZh: 在主要旅行产品购买的同时，推荐航班保障和灵活变更服务等辅助产品。这种设置带来了粒度模糊性：同一产品类型内的SKU共享语义，但在价格和覆盖范围上有所不同，而拒绝一个报价并不意味着对整个类型不感兴趣。我们提出了PEETS（偏好感知嵌入与显式树结构），这是一个用于辅助产品捆绑的训练时框架。PEETS通过两个条件比较对现有的点击-转化预测器进行正则化。分层对比损失使用配对的共同祖先作为参考；负对比损失将结构采样和比较偏移条件化于记录的拒绝事件上。两者在训练期间作用于共享的SKU表示。这将目录相关性与个体偏好监督分开，并保持预测服务路径不变。PEETS达到78.20%的AUC，超过TWIN V2 0.90个百分点，超过匹配的基础模型1.15个百分点。在为期14天的在线评估中，每个曝光用户日的辅助总GMV相比Policies提升8.20%，相比Base提升3.06%，相比TWIN V2提升0.84%，三个用户自助法95%置信区间均高于零。捆绑率比Policies低0.51个百分点。取消区间的上限超过预设边际。PEETS在服务中不增加辅助损失计算，记录的p95延迟为42.1毫秒，而Base为42.0毫秒。
